class.name: OcgSelect3dSensitiveprimitivearray
class.brief_description: Sensitive for triangulation or point set defined by Primitive Array. The primitives can be optionally combined into patches within BVH tree to reduce its building time in expense of extra traverse time.
class.description: ! Sensitive for triangulation or point set defined by Primitive Array. ! The primitives can be optionally combined into patches within BVH tree ! to reduce its building time in expense of extra traverse time.

method.name: Select3D_SensitivePrimitiveArray
method.description: Constructs an empty sensitive object.

method.name: PatchSizeMax
method.description: Return patch size limit (1 by default).

method.name: SetPatchSizeMax
method.description: Assign patch size limit. Should be set before initialization.

method.name: PatchDistance
method.description: Maximum allowed distance between consequential elements in patch (ShortRealLast() by default). Has no effect on indexed triangulation.

method.name: SetPatchDistance
method.description: Assign patch distance limit. Should be set before initialization.

method.name: InitTriangulation_2
method.description: Initialize the sensitive object from triangualtion. The sub-triangulation can be specified by arguments theIndexLower and theIndexUpper (these are for iterating theIndices, not to restrict the actual index values!).

method.name: InitTriangulation_1
method.description: Initialize the sensitive object from triangualtion.

method.name: InitPoints_3
method.description: Initialize the sensitive object from point set. The sub-set of points can be specified by arguments theIndexLower and theIndexUpper (these are for iterating theIndices, not to restrict the actual index values!).

method.name: InitPoints_2
method.description: Initialize the sensitive object from point set.

method.name: InitPoints_1
method.description: Initialize the sensitive object from point set.

method.name: ToDetectElements
method.description: Return flag to keep index of last topmost detected element, TRUE by default.

method.name: SetDetectElements
method.description: Setup keeping of the index of last topmost detected element (axis picking).

method.name: ToDetectElementMap
method.description: Return flag to keep index map of last detected elements, FALSE by default (rectangle selection).

method.name: SetDetectElementMap
method.description: Setup keeping of the index map of last detected elements (rectangle selection).

method.name: ToDetectNodes
method.description: Return flag to keep index of last topmost detected node, FALSE by default.

method.name: SetDetectNodes
method.description: Setup keeping of the index of last topmost detected node (for axis picking).

method.name: ToDetectNodeMap
method.description: Return flag to keep index map of last detected nodes, FALSE by default (rectangle selection).

method.name: SetDetectNodeMap
method.description: Setup keeping of the index map of last detected nodes (rectangle selection).

method.name: ToDetectEdges
method.description: Return flag to keep index of last topmost detected edge, FALSE by default.

method.name: SetDetectEdges
method.description: Setup keeping of the index of last topmost detected edge (axis picking).

method.name: LastDetectedElement
method.description: Return last topmost detected element or -1 if undefined (axis picking).

method.name: LastDetectedElementMap
method.description: Return the index map of last detected elements (rectangle selection).

method.name: LastDetectedNode
method.description: Return last topmost detected node or -1 if undefined (axis picking).

method.name: LastDetectedNodeMap
method.description: Return the index map of last detected nodes (rectangle selection).

method.name: LastDetectedEdgeNode1
method.description: Return the first node of last topmost detected edge or -1 if undefined (axis picking).

method.name: LastDetectedEdgeNode2
method.description: Return the second node of last topmost detected edge or -1 if undefined (axis picking).

method.name: DumpJson
method.description: Dumps the content of me into the stream

method.name: Size
method.description: Returns the length of array of triangles or edges

method.name: NbSubElements
method.description: Returns the amount of nodes in triangulation

method.name: Center
method.description: Returns geometry center of triangle/edge with index theIdx in array along the given axis theAxis

method.name: Swap
method.description: Swaps items with indexes theIdx1 and theIdx2 in array

method.name: CenterOfGeometry
method.description: Returns center of triangulation. If location transformation is set, it will be applied

method.name: HasInitLocation
method.description: Returns true if the shape corresponding to the entity has init location

method.name: InvInitLocation
method.description: Returns inversed location transformation matrix if the shape corresponding to this entity has init location set. Otherwise, returns identity matrix.

method.name: Set
method.description: Sets the owner for all entities in group
